name: Seera Finis Victoria
original_name: セーラ＝フィニス＝ヴィクトリア
source:
Seera is a Fourth-Tier magician and the daughter of [url=/c12408]Elda[/url]. She is a genius at magic and at times, very arrogant.

She is also a cousin of [url=/c25812]Karen[/url] from 77.
